content: Localhost HTTP servers are reachable from any website the user visits: the browser enforces same-origin by hostname, not IP, so an attacker domain rebound to 127.0.0.1 is treated as same-origin. CVE-2025-66414 (MCP TypeScript SDK, Dec 2025, CVSS 7.6) let any web page drive localhost MCP servers with no CORS error. Mitigation is Origin AND Host header validation (403 on mismatch), an explicit allowed-hosts list, binding 127.0.0.1 rather than 0.0.0.0, and no wildcard CORS.
